name: AnswerPage

class.value:
[
  'option-item',
  {
    selected: this.isOptionSelected(this.context.q.id, this.context.oidx),
    correct:
      this.state.showResult && this.context.oidx === this.context.q.answer,
    wrong:
      this.state.showResult &&
      this.isOptionSelected(this.context.q.id, this.context.oidx) &&
      this.context.oidx !== this.context.q.answer
  }
]

children.value: this.isCorrect(this.context.q) ? '✓ 回答正确' : '✗ 回答错误'
